instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot at eye-level. Inside a martial arts gym with grey mats, the man in the grey t-shirt (R2) on the left and the man in the white t-shirt (R1) on the right are grappling in a close clinch. The man in the grey t-shirt (R2) wears black shorts and black-and-yellow shin guards, wrapping his arms tightly around his partner's upper body. The man in the white t-shirt (R1) wears blue shorts and white shin guards, leaning forward into the hold. In the background, two bystanders stand near training equipment. Neutral indoor overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the grey floor.
